light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

Behind the low red brick wall on the right the neighbour leans with a coffee mug. Same clothes: faded olive-green work shirt with rolled sleeves and the worn brown leather apron. clips.text: La sal ayuda a que la cal seque más despacio y agarre mejor. Pero es un puñado por balde. Uno. No más.
clips.action: he holds up the glass jar of coarse salt to the camera, serious. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Si te pasas de sal, la pared te la devuelve: salen estas manchas blancas, como pelusa, y la cal se suelta ahí.
clips.action: he points at a white powdery bloom stain on an old wall in the corner of the patio. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Y siempre disuelta en agua caliente. En grano se queda en puntitos, y cada puntito es un lugar donde se va a soltar.
clips.action: he shakes the salt jar and then puts it down on the low wall. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Poca sal, bien disuelta, y la pared húmeda durante el curado.
clips.action: he holds the pump sprayer and talks to the camera, calm. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Eso es lo que casi nadie hace bien. Y es lo que hace que no se caiga.
clips.action: he mists the white wall with the sprayer one more time. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Así que, ¿loco o genio? Ninguno de los dos. Esto es lo que hacían los abuelos, y lo olvidamos porque la lata es más cómoda.
clips.action: he stands at the line where the old wall used to be, gesturing to the whole white wall. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Cuatro de cal, una de cemento, un puñado de sal disuelta, agua hasta leche. Pared mineral y mojada. Manos finas. Curado con rocío.
clips.action: he counts on his fingers the key rules while talking. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Si lo haces así, tienes una pared que respira, que no se descascara, y que cuesta muy poco.
clips.action: he picks up the bucket and brush and points at the camera. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Y si te da miedo, pruébala primero en un pedazo chico, atrás de la casa. Una semana. Si te convence, pintas todo.
clips.action: he gestures toward the back corner of the house, suggesting a small test. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: La hoja con todo, y los demás arreglos de la casa, están en la guía del canal. El código en pantalla o el enlace abajo.
clips.action: he puts the bucket down and talks to the camera, relaxed. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Y cuéntame en los comentarios qué pared vas a pintar. Nos vemos en el próximo arreglo.
clips.action: he nods to the neighbor behind the low wall and back to the camera, warm. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.
